ns2:course.label: Doctoral Seminar in Music Education
ns2:course.description: Weekly seminar involving special topic discussions on critical issues within the profession. Required each semester for all resident doctoral students in music education during their residency. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music education.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music education.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Music Education major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
